dispositions.reason: 한 둘이냐 is a rhetorical denial that the Fame handshakes were few; restored the many-not-few count so Gwak Jun is one of a crowd.
오태산 romanizes as Mount Otae, matching the two syllables on the page.
허어 is impressed astonishment from the Head Elder, not a request for clarification.
시커먼 describes the men’s looks, not dark clothing; clothing color is specified later for Gwak Jun’s group only.
Restored the stated total 도합 사백오십 rather than leaving the sum implicit.
두 배에 달하는 is twice the numbers, not nearly twice.
